extraction.Name: Alice Brown
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. recorded Jul. 18, 1919, by Home Abstract Co. Martin, So. Dak.
extraction.Buyer: On July 26, 1921, mortgaged to Mary Volz and Charles Volz of Martin; On July 18, 1919 mortgaged to Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. Dak. for $594.75; On Jan. 15, 1920 mortgaged to McKinney & Allen, Sioux Falls, So. Dak. for $1600.00; On May 3, 1924, sold at Sheriff's Sale by advertisement for $2003.85, to Lois C. extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 1, 1918; Patent recorded Jul. 28, 1921; Taken from the records at the County Seat; Bennett County Bank Satisfaction of Mortgage dated July 18, 1919, recorded Feb. 17, 1920; McKinney & Allen assigned mortgage dated Jan. 15, 1920 to Lois C.
